critical_paths.title: Retire bounded architecture exceptions
critical_paths.threshold: No new exception and every retained exception has exact issue-backed disposition
critical_paths.rollback_trigger: An exception is removed without passing its recorded retirement criteria.
critical_paths.rollback_procedure: Restore the last valid disposition and reopen issue #26 before merge.

critical_paths.title: Maintain solo-owner protected-branch controls
critical_paths.metric: Provider-verified required certification and unresolved-thread enforcement
critical_paths.threshold: Zero impossible human approvals; exact-head repository-certification, resolved threads, squash-only merge, and linear history remain enforced
critical_paths.rollback_trigger: Required certification, thread resolution, squash-only merge, linear history, deletion protection, or force-push protection weakens.
critical_paths.rollback_procedure: Restore the versioned solo-maintainer ruleset contract and reopen issue #27 before another merge.

critical_paths.title: Resolve code-verifiable comparative capability gaps
critical_paths.metric: Comparative capability claims without executable evidence
critical_paths.rollback_trigger: A comparative claim exceeds the capability represented by executable repository evidence.
critical_paths.rollback_procedure: Revert the unsupported claim or capability change and reopen issue #28.

critical_paths.title: Keep knowledge, dependencies, and governance evidence current
critical_paths.metric: Overdue knowledge, dependency, or governance evidence
critical_paths.rollback_trigger: A freshness, dependency, or governance check regresses after maintenance.
critical_paths.rollback_procedure: Revert the maintenance change, preserve the failing evidence, and reopen issue #29.

critical_paths.title: Provide a monitored private conduct-reporting channel
critical_paths.threshold: Exactly one documented and monitored private destination
critical_paths.rollback_trigger: The private destination becomes public, unmonitored, or inaccessible.
critical_paths.rollback_procedure: Mark the control blocked, remove the invalid destination, and reopen issue #30.
critical_paths.blocker: No monitored private conduct-reporting destination is configured; the owner must provision and attest one.

critical_paths.title: Maintain incident, recovery, and rollback runbooks
critical_paths.metric: Critical operational paths without rehearsable recovery guidance
critical_paths.rollback_trigger: A documented recovery action is destructive, incomplete, or cannot restore the last good state.
critical_paths.rollback_procedure: Revert the runbook change and keep issue #31 open until a safe recovery rehearsal passes.

critical_paths.title: Keep integrated certification and governance metrics enforceable
critical_paths.metric: Required certification paths bypassed or non-reproducible
critical_paths.threshold: Zero bypassed required paths at the exact reviewed commit
critical_paths.rollback_trigger: A required certification path is bypassed or its evidence becomes non-reproducible.
critical_paths.rollback_procedure: Restore the last passing certification contract and reopen issue #32.
